question:
**Consider the following statements about India's Winter Olympics participation: **

1) Shiva Keshavan competed in six Games and introduced luge to India.

2) Arif Mohammad Khan was the first Indian to qualify for two alpine skiing events in 2022. Which of the statements is/are **correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3: Both statements 1 and 2 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shiva Keshavan** is a six-time Winter Olympian from India and is widely regarded as the pioneer of luge in India.
 
• He was the first Indian to represent the country in luge at the Winter Olympics, beginning his journey at Nagano in 1998.
 
• **Arif Mohammad Khan** made history by becoming the first Indian to qualify for two alpine skiing events at the Winter Olympics 2022 in Beijing.
 
• Arif represented India in **slalom and giant slalom events**, showcasing his remarkable skills in alpine skiing.
 
• India has a limited yet impactful presence at the Winter Olympics, with athletes like Shiva Keshavan and Arif Mohammad Khan bringing global attention to winter sports in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India's Participation in the Winter Olympics:**

 
 
• India's Winter Olympics journey began in 1964, with sporadic participation in skiing, luge, and other sports.
 
• Due to geographical and infrastructural limitations, winter sports in India have not gained widespread popularity.
 
• Efforts are being made to encourage winter sports through initiatives like training programs and international exposure.
